people.name: Samaria
people.line: Capital city of the northern kingdom of Israel; Samaritan inhabitants

translations.web: You will be filled with drunkenness and sorrow, with the cup of astonishment and desolation, with the cup of your sister Samaria.
translations.bsb: You will be filled with drunkenness and grief, with a cup of devastation and desolation, the cup of your sister Samaria.
